Under that top shelf its front is carved as a single dragon head with a blunt long snout and short thick horns. Back is a completely flat vertical plane; top completely flat. No surrounding wall, no beam, no floor pedestal. Dimensions 24 inches wide, 24 deep, 30 tall. The carving dominates the room-facing front and is readable when this bracket sits just under a beam. Front faces +Z, wall mounting back -Z. Palette: burnt copper and deep crimson. Stout connected forms, broad bevels, clear part separation, matte painted gradients, restrained surface texture, no glossy PBR. Exactly one complete object centered with generous clear margin, no scene or additional objects, no text, no logos, no specific published mythology or recognizable product design. Three-quarter view from ABOVE, camera elevation 50 degrees so the top and front are visible. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.
